docs/animation/STORYTIME_REFINEMENT_WORK.note: Applies the upper-middle visual balance approved in Nemi EP11 R10 to EP13: Nemi's bedroom studio setup, sequential development of Discord server and Ko-fi support without screen clutter, stable cream paper with plum linework, phrase-paced Sohee voice (target ~90s runtime hard limit), and strict 1080p preview approval before any 4K master.

docs/animation/STORYTIME_DIRECTION_WORKF.note: V2 direction workflow for EP13: clear narrative arc (Promise: awkward confession / Want: keep animating without burning out / Choice: opening community corner & Ko-fi / Consequence: balancing bashful emo doubt with cheerful hope / Payoff: warm invitation to hang out). One primary focus per beat, eye-led transitions, grounded posture, and purposeful framing.

docs/animation/CHARACTER_DRAWING_PRODUCT.note: Nemi's distinct plum linework and rounded shapes; drawings for EP13 include a live doodle of a Discord speech bubble/corner sign, a steaming Ko-fi mug with a heart, and a humorous messy animation timeline sketch. Completed ink remains still without procedural jitter.

docs/Nemi_Animation_Personality_Guide.md.note: Captures Nemi's signature emo-cheerful duality: shy, self-deprecating, bashful hand gestures, sudden bursts of passionate energy when talking about drawing, embarrassed nervous chuckles, and genuine heartfelt gratitude without whiny or transactional pressure.

docs/Nemi_Character_Bible.md.note: Honors Nemi's established persona: late-night animator working at her desk, drinking iced coffee, struggling with self-doubt yet deeply loving her audience. Addresses the viewer as an intimate confidant/friend, inviting them into "Nemi's little corner" as a cozy safe space.

docs/Nemi_Dialogue_Guide.md.note: Natural, conversational cadence with authentic pauses, self-interruptions, and bashful corrections. Avoids corporate sponsor-speak; phrases Discord and Ko-fi casually as options to hang out or buy her a digital coffee if they enjoy her stories.

common/storytime/profiles/nemi.json.note: Standard character profile parameters for Nemi: warm plum ink (#4A2E35), cream paper (#F9F6EE), canonical proportions, facial expressions, and hand pose configurations appropriate for desk/room animation staging.

common/storytime/examples/story_review_4.note: Quality assurance review benchmark: verify full-body acting, hands and feet framing in wider shots, seamless transition into medium/close-up portrait shots during emotional confessions, prop persistence (tablet stylus, coffee mug), and sound audibility beneath narration.

docs/animation/STORYTIME_EPISODE_COLOUR_.note: Restrained storytime paper palette referencing EP06 "How I Animate": warm cream textured paper, dark readable plum ink, muted watercolor washes for her room/desk, selective purple/periwinkle tint for Discord accents and warm caramel for Ko-fi accents.

docs/animation/COMMON_ANIMATION_QA.md.note: QA checklist compliance for EP13: zero sliding root motion, proper arm length constraints (forearm/wrist angle tracking), no orphan gripping hands when releasing stylus/mug, synced mouth phonemes with Sohee voice, and verified caption timing.

tools/tts/config.py.note: Canonical voice configuration: Sohee voice model, preserved pitch/formants/EQ without distortion. Authored phrase tempo adjusted between 1.05-1.12x to maintain engaging rhythm while preserving emotional beats, hesitation, and heartfelt tone.

docs/animation/COMMON_CAMERA_STAGING.md.note: Camera staging plan: opens on a cozy wide of Nemi at her desk, cuts to medium portrait as she nervously broaches the topic, punch-in close-up on bashful/emo expression, insert cut to her tablet screen showing Discord and Ko-fi doodles, and returns to a warm medium-close for the final thank-you.

docs/animation/COMMON_SFX_SYSTEM.md.note: Event-linked sound design: subtle tablet stylus scribbles, Discord notification ping accent, warm liquid pour/mug clink for Ko-fi, record scratch or nervous comic boing during awkward hesitation, and soft comedic pop for doodle reveals. Auditioned and balanced beneath Sohee's narration.

docs/animation/LIVE_DOODLING_WORKFLOW.md.note: Live ink execution: authored sequential strokes for the Discord icon/server sign and Ko-fi mug doodle. Drawing speed matches conversational rhythm, settling into a stable held graphic without continuous procedural looping.

docs/animation/COMMON_PROP_SYSTEM.md.note: Prop management: drawing tablet, stylus pen, and ceramic coffee mug. Defined attachment points, clean pick-up and set-down transitions, ensuring hand poses return to neutral/gesture states upon prop release.

docs/audio/SFX_System_Guide.md.note: Sound integration architecture: routing voice, SFX, and ambient room tones to appropriate audio buses, applying gain staging to ensure voice clarity, and linking audio triggers strictly to scene clock timestamps.

docs/audio/SFX_License_Registry.md.note: Provenance verification: use only pre-cleared root SFX assets from common/audio/sfx/root_sfx_inventory.json and local sound library with validated hashes and licenses. No synthetic or unauthorized third-party audio clips.
